name: instant-save
title: Instant Save
summary: Saves each change in Settings > Main Menu straight away..
description: The iPod saves its settings at once when you change a row in Settings > Main Menu. Without this patch, the iPod saves them only when it sleeps or connects to a computer. A restart with Menu+Select before that removes the change.
details: A change in Settings > Main Menu stays after a restart with Menu+Select.
This includes the Album Artists row of the Album Artists patch.
notes: Each change writes the settings file. On an iPod with a hard drive, the drive can start.
The other settings (for example Shuffle and Repeat) still save only at a sleep.
Without this patch: put the iPod to sleep (hold Play) before a restart to keep a change.

steps: Flash a firmware with this patch.
On the iPod, open Settings > Main Menu.
Change a row, for example Songs.
Restart the iPod: hold Menu and Select.
Open Settings > Main Menu. The change is still there.
